title: ProofMeta License Type
description: A reusable license definition. Describes what someone is allowed to do, under what terms, and at what price. Can be applied to any item by any provider.

id.description: Unique identifier for this license type. Use it in manifests and requests.

scope.description: What the licensee is allowed (and not allowed) to do. At least one core tag required. See scope-vocabulary.md in primitive-core.

terms_url.description: URL to the full human-readable license text.

terms_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the terms document. Proves the terms haven't changed since the license was agreed.

pricing.description: Optional. How much it costs. Omit for ask-to-price or negotiated licenses.

model.description: free = no cost. one-time = pay once. subscription = recurring. usage-based = pay per use.

amount.description: Price as string to avoid floating point issues. e.g. '5.00'

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code or crypto ticker. e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'USDC'

unit.description: Only for usage-based model. What counts as one use. e.g. 'request', 'minute', 'token'
